slides.headline: THESE 6 AI PROMPTS REPLACE HOURS OF RESEARCH, PREP, AND COMPARISON WITH A 30-SECOND CONVERSATION
1) DIGEST A 200 PAGE DOCUMENT IN 60 SECONDS
slides.body: A 94-page report takes most people half a day to digest. "Read this entire document. Give me the 5 most important points, anything that could cost me money, and one thing the author buried"

slides.headline: 2) RESEARCH ANYONE BEFORE YOU MEET THEM
slides.body: Researching someone for a meeting takes 2 hours minimum. "Tell me everything public about [name]. Their career, recent interviews, what they care about, and 3 things to mention that impress them"

slides.headline: 3) COMPARE ANY PURCHASE IN 30 SECONDS
slides.body: People research purchases for 8 hours and still pick wrong. "I need [X]. Compare the top 5 options by price, features I need, hidden costs, and tell me which to pick"

slides.headline: 4) LEARN ANY NEW SKILL IN ONE WEEK
slides.body: Online courses take 40 hours and cost $500. "I want to learn [skill] from zero. Build a 7-day plan, one hour a day. Day 1 makes me dangerous enough to hold a conversation"

slides.headline: 5) SIZE UP ANY MARKET BEFORE YOU START
slides.body: Proper market research takes 3 weeks. Most people skip it. "I want to start [X]. Who already does this, what they charge, where they're weak, and the fastest path to my first $1,000"

slides.headline: 6) GET A BRUTAL SECOND OPINION ON ANY DECISION
slides.body: People spend days going back and forth on big decisions. "Here's a decision I'm making: [decision]. Give me 3 reasons it's terrible, 3 it's great, and what I'm not seeing"

slides.headline: SAVE THIS POST
slides.body: You'll want these prompts the next time you need to look anything up. Save it now. Daily AI skills and news you can use tonight

hook_tournament.why: Everyone uses Google — calling it 'slow' is a provocation that lands in under a second and makes you feel like you're missing something real. [4] is punchy but 'homework' skews young and the benefit is generic; 'make Google look slow' is a specific, ego-poking claim that works on anyone.

candidates: 6 AI PROMPTS THAT MAKE GOOGLE LOOK SLOW
6 AI PROMPTS SMARTER THAN ANY GOOGLE SEARCH
hook_sharpen.why: OBSOLETE is the most dramatic word in the set — it implies a total replacement, not just a comparison, which makes the brain go 'wait, really?' SMARTER THAN ANY GOOGLE SEARCH is just as clean but 'smarter' feels like a softer, more expected claim you've heard a hundred times before.
